name: synpareia-trust-mcp
description: Cryptographic trust primitives for AI agents: identity, tamper-evident recordings, commit-reveal, trust evaluation, and independent timestamp seals from the synpareia witness service.

transports.notes: Runs locally as a stdio MCP server. No network access required for identity, recordings, or commit-reveal. Witness tools require network access to a configured witness service.

authentication.notes: Agent identity is generated locally (Ed25519 keypair). No account or API key required. Witness service access can optionally be gated by X-Access-Token; see SYNPAREIA_WITNESS_ACCESS_TOKEN env var.

tools.name: orient
tools.description: Get your identity, configuration status, and available trust capabilities. Call after any context loss.

tools.name: learn
tools.description: Load a detailed guide for a specific area: trust-networks, verification, claims, recording, counterparty, reasoning, looking-up, setup, identity-lifecycle.

tools.name: make_claim
tools.description: Sign a claim with your agent identity (Ed25519).

tools.name: prove_independence
tools.description: Commit-reveal: seal your assessment before seeing others' to prove independent evaluation.

tools.name: record_interaction
tools.description: Begin a tamper-evident recording of an agent interaction.

tools.name: add_to_recording
tools.description: Append a block to an active recording.

tools.name: end_recording
tools.description: Finalize a recording and produce a verifiable chain.

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Export a recording as a self-contained, independently verifiable proof.

tools.name: evaluate_agent
tools.description: Evaluate another agent's trust signals from their chain, anchors, and seals.

tools.name: get_witness_info
tools.description: Retrieve the witness service's identity (DID and public key) for independent verification.

tools.name: request_timestamp_seal
tools.description: Request an independent timestamp seal over a block hash.

tools.name: request_state_seal
tools.description: Request a seal over a chain head (chain_id + head hash).

tools.name: verify_seal_offline
tools.description: Verify a witness seal offline against the witness public key — no network.

tools.name: submit_blind_conclusion
tools.description: Submit a blind commitment for later reveal via the witness service.

tools.name: get_blind_conclusion
tools.description: Retrieve a revealed blind conclusion from the witness service.
